# Support

Ways to get help with `Inandu.Grid.Extensions`:

- **Questions and usage help** — [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/inandusolutions/inandu-grid-extensions/discussions)
- **Bug reports and feature requests** — [open an issue](https://github.com/inandusolutions/inandu-grid-extensions/issues/new/choose)
- **Request contract & docs** — [docs/](../docs/), starting with [request-contract.md](../docs/request-contract.md)
- **The Angular grid this serves** — [inandu-grid](https://github.com/inandusolutions/inandu-grid) and its
  [user manual](https://inandusolutions.github.io/inandu-grid/manual.html)
- **Security reports** — see [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md); please don't open a public issue

For commercial support, see <https://www.inandu.com>.
